tagline: Lock the iPad to a single app
description:
**Kiosk Mode** locks your iPad (or iPhone) to a single app and relaunches it automatically — turn a device into a single-purpose kiosk.

This is the setup app: pick the target app and manage the kiosk settings from a simple onboarding flow. The lock and auto-relaunch behaviour lives in the companion SpringBoard tweak (**KioskMode**, package `com.max.kioskmode`) — install both for the full feature.

- Choose any installed app to lock to
- Auto-relaunch if the app is closed
- Escape a locked session with a volume-button triple-press

Built for iOS/iPadOS 17+, rootless (`/var/jb`). Requires **AppSync Unified** to run this unsigned app.

changelog.notes:
- Onboarding + settings app for Kiosk Mode
- Packaged for the repo (app half of the KioskMode project)
